dataset: OpenNeuro ds001226 sub-CON03 preop; actual fixed inputs and 5 FNIT tracking seeds
design: 5 supplied official repeats and 5 FNIT runs; existing TCK only

metric_policy.acceptance: errors <= maximum observed official-pair error; similarities >= minimum observed official-pair similarity
metric_policy.sampling: finite observed repeat range, not a population confidence interval; no post-hoc tolerance
metric_policy.seed_attempts: caller supplies attempted seed count; TCK total_count is not the denominator
metric_policy.length_ks: two-sample KS on stored polyline lengths; scipy.stats.ks_2samp default method
metric_policy.endpoint_histogram: all first/last world-coordinate points; common 8 mm bins from all runs
metric_policy.tdi: stored point-visit counts, np.rint world-to-common-grid; Pearson on union nonzero support; not MRtrix tckmap
metric_policy.coarse_tdi: sum nonoverlapping 4 x 4 x 4 voxel blocks; physical size comes from supplied grid
metric_policy.undefined: null and not_assessed; never zero or a pass
metric_policy.scope: descriptive tractogram population comparison, not a proof of identical RNG or full pipeline parity
